description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Callstack 维护的 React Native 组件套件，按 Google Material Design 给齐一整套可定制组件，并用 Material You 做主题系统。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by React Native Paper (https://oss.callstack.com/react-native-paper/).
Technology stack: react, react-native.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 页头是三段导航 Guides、Components、Showcase 加一个搜索框，右端一枚 5.x 版本下拉。首屏左边大字 “Cross-platform Material Design for React Native”，右边一段说明加 Get started 与 Try on Snack 两个按钮。再往下是虚线描边的卡片网格：第一行 Production-ready components、Material You theming、Accessible by default，第二行 Cross-platform parity、Dark mode support、Migration-friendly docs，六张卡各配一句解释，比如 Material You 那张写的是把 Material 3 的颜色、字体、elevation 和 state layer 交给主题系统。页脚落款 Copyright © 2026 Callstack。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
